words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, the request the case itself writes.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals active.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals active.
